blocks.text: The mechanism of action is how a drug works at the level of the cell to produce its medical effect. Two famous medicines are aspirin and penicillin. The action of aspirin in blocking the COX enzyme was covered in Chemistry XI, so the mechanism of action of penicillin is discussed here.
